text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xx and timeouts for gateway 'edge-proxy' (5m window). 5xx rate 18%, p95 latency 1.2s. Alert ID INC-2950-1
alex: I'm paged, looking.
mira: oncall here, joining. what's the scope?
sam: customer telemetry shows increased failures for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings from eu-west region.
jordan: logs show a flood of KV read errors and timeouts from the prefix-cache: 'ERR: kv read timeout' and 'eviction in progress' traces.
lucy: also seeing a huge spike in cache miss rate and prefetch bursts — looks like a local hot-shard eviction storm.
alex: can we get hot-shard heatmap? sam, paste the query you ran.
sam: query: `select shard, miss_rate, evictions from prefix_metrics where ts > now() - 5m order by miss_rate desc limit 10;`
sam: results: s-12 miss_rate=0.72 evictions=1245; s-13 miss_rate=0.61 evictions=980; s-14 miss_rate=0.45 evictions=620
mira: that matches the symptom — eviction churn -> cache misses -> paging to DB -> higher latency and upstream 502/504s.
alex: quick mitigations we can do now: (1) divert traffic off hot shards, (2) reduce prefetch aggressiveness, (3) raise cache TTL to reduce churn, (4) add temporary backpressure to avoid simultaneous DB paging.
jordan: I can push a routing adjustment to divert 20% of incoming inference traffic away from s-12 to healthy shards.
deploy-bot: /run route-adjust --shard s-12 --percent 20 --reason "eviction storm mitigation"
deploy-bot: started job job-5873
alex: mira — can you push a config tweak for the prefix engine? lower PREFETCH_MAX_KEYS and increase TTL?
mira: making change: PREFETCH_MAX_KEYS: 500 -> 200; PREFIX_CACHE_TTL: 60s -> 300s. Deploying config via canary.
mira: applying to eu-west canary pool now, will watch.
pagerduty-bot: pager acknowledged by alex (oncall).
sam: logs (snippet):
```text
2026-02-14T18:02:12Z prefix-cache[s-12]: WARN eviction: evicted 452 keys in 1s
2026-02-14T18:02:12Z prefix-cache[s-12]: ERROR read_timeout: context deadline exceeded
2026-02-14T18:02:13Z gateway: 502 upstream read timeout for request id=abc123
```
alex: after the routing change and TTL bump, 5xx rate dropped from ~18% to ~4% within 3 minutes. p95 latency trending down.
lucy: customer impact summary: major customers A and B saw spikes between 17:58-18:08 UTC; A reported ~0.8% of requests failed in that window, B had increased retries. No widespread data loss.
mira: continuing to monitor. Keeping canary config for 30 minutes then roll to prod if stable.
sam: action items from this thread: write postmortem, add circuit-breaker on eviction surge, implement per-shard backpressure to prevent paging waterfall, tighten alert thresholds for rapid miss-ramp.
alex: +1 to circuit-breaker; also add a metric that alerts on sustained evictions > X/s per shard.
lucy: I'll prepare customer comms draft noting mitigation steps and timeline; will CC accounts impacted.
alex: good job team. Marking incident as mitigated for now :white_check_mark:. Please keep monitoring for 30m.
incident-bot: Incident mitigation note: temporary routing adjustment + cache TTL increase applied. Followup: create postmortem ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-472
mira: handing off to next-oncall sam for monitoring; I'm stepping out.
sam: taking over monitoring. Will update if regressions.
jordan: linking runbook for followup work: https://docs.redwood-internal/runbooks/prefix-cache-eviction
lucy: will close the thread after 30m of stability and file the postmortem.
